verdict.rationale: Kimi does ship automation-type features: the help center lists scheduled tasks (定时任务) and agent tasks. So the axis applies, but no evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. The API path versioning and model deprecation table cover API and model lifecycle, which is a different capability and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
